A1.justification: Both readable, ten-page PDFs describe the same fMRI-LM work. Text and rendered pages match except for the arXiv version/date stamp. Appendices A–G are referenced but absent from both PDFs, with no embedded supplements; this comparison covers all supplied material.

before.justification: v1 reports original fMRI-LM classification and regression experiments in Tables 3–4, alongside descriptor, generalization, instruction-tuning, and ablation results in Figures 3 and 6–10.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original experimental results in Tables 3–4 and Figures 3 and 6–10.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the identical descriptor construction, text-aligned tokenizer, temporal/text modeling objectives, and multi-task instruction-tuning procedure. No algorithm, architecture, loss, or inference component changes.

E1.justification: Table 2 and Section 4 retain the same seven datasets, prediction targets, question-answering formats, and three zero-/few-shot transfer scenarios. No training or evaluation coverage changes.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains BrainNetCNN, BrainGNN, BNT, FBNETGEN, SWiFT, BrainLM, BrainMass, and Brain-JEPA. Table 4 retains SWiFT, BrainMass, and Brain-JEPA. Comparator participation in the figures is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported protocols are identical, including the 80/20 pretraining split, 450 ROIs, 160 time points, model configurations, 50-epoch training, evaluation metrics, and 2-, 4-, and 10-shot settings. Referenced appendix-only details are unavailable in both PDFs.

E4.justification: The descriptor analyses, transfer tests, and ablations of descriptors, LoRA, and pretraining-data size are unchanged in Figures 3 and 6–10. Appendix G's additional ablations are referenced identically but included in neither supplied PDF.

E5.justification: Tables 3–4 retain identical parenthesized quantities and the same reporting practice. Neither supplied text adds or changes explanations of uncertainty, run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All supplied numerical entries and plotted results are identical. For example, Table 3 retains fMRI-LM-B(G) UKB-sex accuracy of 94.89 and ADNI-AD accuracy of 77.92; Table 4 retains UKB-age MAE of 1.82. No reported rankings or qualitative findings change.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–6 are identical, including quantization, alignment, temporal prediction, and combined objectives. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion are identical. Claims about language-aligned fMRI modeling, the descriptive corpus, generalization, and parameter-efficient adaptation retain the same scope.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same interpretations and qualifications, including weak strict zero-shot performance, ADNI underperformance, hypothesized population differences, and the benefits attributed to joint training and LoRA.

D1.justification: Preprocessing, prompt generation, model sizes, patch size, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, and freezing schedules are unchanged. Both still promise future code/checkpoint availability and refer to implementation appendices absent from the supplied PDFs.

R1.justification: The same 40 references and related-work discussion remain. Positioning relative to neural-only foundation models, EEG-language models, and stimulus-dependent fMRI-to-text decoding is unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv stamp changes, from v1 dated 24 Nov 2025 to v2 dated 26 Dec 2025. The paper's wording, terminology, headings, and section structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–10, Tables 1–4, captions, equations, and page layout are identical. Rendered pages differ only in the first-page version/date text, already accounted for under P1.

improvement.justification: The supplied PDFs have identical scientific content, results, explanations, and visual presentation. Updating the arXiv stamp provides no meaningful quality improvement or deterioration. The referenced appendices remain absent from both supplied files.
